mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightening indicated by UNRATE falling below 5.0% for two consecutive months signals reduced unemployment risk and stronger corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has been below 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply chain expansion (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly), increased industrial production supports corporate output and profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 120.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer spending trend (RSAFS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals strong household demand, which supports corporate sales and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has grown by more than 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market boom (HOUST growth > 1.0% monthly), increased residential construction activity drives consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST growth exceeds 1.0%.
